title: Rendered contrast, reflow, keyboard journeys and image framing
scope: Twenty-one representative reader routes. Initial, hovered navigation and keyboard-focused states; Chromium only. Equivalent CSS viewport reflow, not browser-toolbar zoom. Plain-language review covers the opening twelve prose blocks and forty link labels of each HTML route. Image checks cover every Questions card on the five Questions routes; artistic crop quality remains visual review.

boundary: One Chromium run and bounded selectors, widths and states. This does not certify accessibility, arbitrary CSS painting, actual browser-toolbar zoom, screen-reader use or comprehension. Reflow, clipping and hit tests are measured; purpose and visual quality require review. Native media/control text and visually hidden input proxies require visual review. Identical repeated host observations are grouped. Image loading, aspect preservation and declared Questions-card frames are measured; image meaning and artistic crops require visual review.
